meta.demand: 宝可梦黑白 NDS 风俯视 RPG 的村庄小屋 sprite：小木屋带红/蓝屋顶、白墙、窗户，3D 等距视角略俯视，像游戏地图上的建筑，硬边像素、同一 NDS 16-bit 调色板、透明背景、无文字
meta.prompt:
Single standalone village hut building sprite for a Nintendo DS-era top-down JRPG map, inspired by Pokemon Black and White overworld architecture props. This is one isolated architectural asset only, not a character, not a sprite sheet, not an animation set, and not multiple directional frames. Fixed 3/4 isometric top-down view with the camera slightly above and angled down, designed to read clearly on a tile-based map.

Design a small wooden cottage with a compact rectangular footprint sized for a 32px tile world: simple pitched roof, red and blue roof panels, white plaster walls, visible dark wooden beams, one front door, two small square windows with frames, tiny chimney, and a low stone base. Keep the geometry chunky and low-detail so it remains legible at game-map scale. Limit the roof overhang, wall ornament, and trim detail to a few clear pixel clusters; avoid dense texture, tiny clutter, or miniature decorative extras.

Hard-edged pixel art only, crisp clustered pixels, clean 1px-style pixel outlines, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients, no painterly shading. Use a restrained Nintendo DS 16-bit palette with saturated but controlled reds, blues, whites, warm browns, and cool gray shadows. Use 3-tone material separation: roof, wall, wood, and stone must each have distinct value steps. Add only subtle integrated sprite shadowing under the eaves and along the base; no separate ground shadow, no terrain, no floor plane.

Center the hut cleanly on the canvas with enough empty margin around the silhouette for the roof peak and overhang. The sprite must be isolated on a true transparent alpha background, with no black matte, no visible backdrop, no scene, no UI, no text, no labels, no overlay, no extra props. Authentic Pokemon Black and White NDS overworld prop aesthetic, game-ready, crisp, readable, and modest in detail density.

issues: 这是一张单视角小屋图，不具备下/左下/左/左上/上/右上/右/右下八向一致性，无法验证角色式多方向要求。
画面更像低分辨率3D或渲染风格，不是典型像素硬边 sprite，边缘存在明显柔化与抗锯齿感。
背景是黑色底而非可确认的透明背景，按透明底素材标准不合格。
作为 32px 瓦片地图素材体量偏大、透视和阴影复杂，直接落图会显得突兀。
整体风格接近村庄小屋，但更偏通用小屋模型图标，不够贴近宝可梦式地图建筑的简洁、扁平、规则轮廓。
improvements: 补齐八向或至少四向视图，并保持屋顶、门窗、烟囱、配色和比例完全一致。
改成真正的像素风硬边绘制，减少平滑渐变、柔边和渲染阴影。
导出真正透明底 PNG，并检查边缘是否有黑底残留和半透明脏边。
按 32px 瓦片地图重新定尺寸与透视，简化细节，让轮廓在小尺寸下依然清晰。
把造型收敛到更接近宝可梦式村庄房屋的读图方式：更清楚的块面、明确的屋顶色块和更少的材质噪声。
vision.summary: 这是一个有村庄小屋方向感的低分辨率图，但不满足透明像素 sprite 和八向行走素材的基本要求，整体判定不通过。
